_doc: Editable topic battery for the experiment suite. Edit freely. `query` is required; `canonical` (landmarks a good review must mention) and `spine` (ordered foundational lineage) are optional and only used by recall metrics. Grouped by design: foundational, frontier, A-fixed-B-varies, B-fixed-A-varies (compositional/relational probes).

testtime.query: test-time compute and reasoning in large language models

moe.query: mixture-of-experts models for scaling neural networks

ssm.query: state space models for sequence modeling

llm_agents.query: large language model agents and tool use

preference_opt.query: preference optimization and RLHF for language models

speculative_decoding.query: speculative decoding for faster LLM inference

diffusion_audio.query: diffusion models for audio and speech synthesis

gnn_drug.query: graph neural networks for drug discovery

gnn_recsys.query: graph neural networks for recommendation systems

gnn_combinatorial.query: graph neural networks for combinatorial optimization

transformer_driving.query: transformer models for autonomous driving perception

rl_theorem.query: reinforcement learning for automated theorem proving
